title: docs(audits): archive the four unreferenced 2026-06 audits (minimum arm)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8P78FdM2BxrU7649uyj3tXo)_

Refs #26257 — **minimum arm** (triage 6431037536, claim 6454039459). The card stays open: the **fuller arm** (the 14 `packages/spec`-cited 2026-06 files, their `liveness/*.json` `_note` paths and zod comments, a spec patch changeset and regenerated references) still needs a `domain:spec` review, and the 6 ADR-cited files stay in place under either arm.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 4 份已无任何入链的 2026-06 审计文档用 `git mv` 移入 `docs/audits/archive/2026-06/`,并改好 README 索引三行与一份文档里的三个 ADR 相对链接。
- 为什么改:落实 #26075 裁决 A 的「已关闭审计归档」一半中的最小臂;只动无人引用的文件,零发布面。
- 风险与回滚:仅 docs,不发布;回滚即 revert 本 PR。无 ADR、无 `packages/spec` 改动,无删除。
- 先看:`docs/audits/README.md`(三行索引路径),`docs/audits/archive/2026-06/2026-06-ask-build-agent-development-assessment.md`(ADR 链接改为 `../../../adr/`)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -nE "2026-06-(ask-build-agent-development-assessment|datasetschema-property-liveness|pageschema-property-liveness|system-integration-property-liveness)" | grep -v archive/2026-06/` 预期零输出。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `git mv` (pure renames, 100% similarity for three) of `docs/audits/2026-06-{ask-build-agent-development-assessment,datasetschema-property-liveness,pageschema-property-liveness,system-integration-property-liveness}.md` into `docs/audits/archive/2026-06/`.
- `docs/audits/README.md`: the three per-type index rows (page, dataset, system/integration) now name `archive/2026-06/…`. The README's existing lifecycle line already says closed audits move to `docs/audits/archive/`, so no new prose.
- `archive/2026-06/2026-06-ask-build-agent-development-assessment.md`: its three relative ADR links (ADR-0040, 0063, 0064; five occurrences) are re-rooted from `../adr/` to `../../../adr/` so they still resolve from the deeper directory. Content otherwise unchanged.

## Tests

Docs-only move; no code or tests touched.

## Acceptance notes

- Re-measured on `origin/main` 5ce3404acd before moving: the four bare filenames had no inbound reference anywhere in the tree except README rows L16, L19 and L28; `ask-build-agent-development-assessment` had none at all. Matches the claim's premise.
- Not done here (out of the minimum arm): the 14 spec-cited and 6 ADR-cited 2026-06 files stay in `docs/audits/`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates on 907b582a6</summary>

```
pnpm check:doc-authoring :: exit 0   (439 files clean; 69 skill files clean; spec strings clean)
pnpm check:adr-links     :: exit 0   (907 relative link destinations under docs/adr/ resolve)
relative-link resolver over docs/audits/README.md + docs/audits/archive/2026-06/*.md :: 9 links checked, 0 dead
git grep for the four old paths outside archive/2026-06/ :: 0 hits
```

The lychee `Check Documentation Links` lane was not run locally (the binary download was refused in this container); CI runs it over `docs/**/*.md`.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` not run locally (markdown-only diff), CI runs it.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset — nothing publishes (`docs/**` is in no package's `files[]`), so `skip-changeset`.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the os-dev contract's Chinese digest).
